item.title: Open-Source Pascal Web Frameworks in 2026: mORMot 2 vs DelphiMVCFramework vs fpWeb
item.description: Object Pascal quietly runs a staggering amount of critical infrastructure: check-in terminals, laboratory instruments, warehouse scanners, and back-office systems that have been compiling with the same toolchain for fifteen years. The catch is that the server side of those systems is usually locked behind a commercial licence — until you look at what the open-source side has been doing.
